implementation/01_SEWCP-200_Cooling_Plate/SEWCP-200_CAD_Implementation_Package.md - S12, feature strategy rows 25-26, section 3 stub parameters

scope.bounded: The two coolant port pockets (CP-D25, ramped), the two radial stub bores (CP-D22/D23), the two weld-prep counterbores (CP-D24), and the CP_BODY+CP_LID combine representing the welded assembly. Continues the saved document; verified base and channel state are prerequisites and are not rebuilt.
scope.deferred: The SEWCP-201 bimetallic transition joints are a separate component and are not modelled here. Below-face features from steps 6.13 onward remain out of scope.
scope.open_state: ECR-Q-011 (FSW minimum rib) remains OPEN; the channel's 5.0 mm rib is provisional and this package does not depend on it. The ~1.64 m developed path versus the ~2.2 m section 2.1 design basis remains an open engineering observation; port geometry is fixed by CP-IF-10 and is independent of both.

requirements.statement: Two radial coolant stubs at 255 (inlet) and 285 (outlet): O10.0 H9 bore (CP-D22) on a centreline 11.00 above Datum A (CP-D23) from the OD to the channel at r=125; O14.0 H8 x 4.0 weld-prep counterbore at the OD (CP-D24); channel locally deepened to 10.00 so bore and pocket section are coaxial, ramped back to 6.00 over 15 mm (CP-D25).
requirements.verification: Bores and pockets present in the observed model; planes and sketches verified; section coaxiality by construction from the parameter stack

requirements.statement: CP_BODY and CP_LID are joined into one body representing the friction-stir-welded assembly (spec/01 section 6 step 5), after the stub features so the pocket cuts act on the two-piece state the machining sequence produces.
requirements.source: spec/01 section 6 step 5; implementation package feature strategy row 26
requirements.verification: One body named CP_BODY, full 20.00 mm stack

requirements.statement: The SEWCP-201 transition joints are orbital-GTAW welded into the CP-D24 counterbores, full penetration, 6061-to-6061 fusion only - the Al/316L interface is the explosion bond inside SEWCP-201 and is never a fusion weld.
Proof pressure 6 bar / 30 min after welding. The port-pocket 4.00 mm top ligament carries 2.8 MPa against 276 MPa yield (spec/01 section 3.1 port exception).

interfaces.nature: Fluid - realised in-plate: pockets, bores and weld preps at 255/285; the SEWCP-201 joints and VCR glands are the mating component

manufacturing.statement: Stub bores and weld preps are machined after the FSW weld and proof test (section 6 steps 7-10); the pockets are milled with the channel at step 3. The model applies them to the joined state via the combine at row 26.
